thread:
sophie (Design): quick thread 1 — UX hierarchy question for the request drilldown: users keep missing the export link buried in the error tooltip. thinking we should move export to the header and make it part of the primary drilldown actions. reactions?

 tom (Product): agree. export in tooltip is hidden. header-level action improves discoverability. but we should decide whether it's primary or secondary visually. export isn't a destructive action but it's higher-value.

 anjali (Eng): implementation heads-up: header export will need current filter + time-range snapshot server-side. we can emit an async job and stream a presigned URL. extra latency ~150-250ms, depending on backend queue.

 noah (A11y): accessibility constraints: button must be in tab order, have a verbose aria-label like `Export trace (req 0b3e4f)` and the export modal must trap focus; on close focus returns to the export button. also ensure color contrast for the icon/button >= 4.5:1.

 sophie (Design): proposal: put Export on the right, grouped with filter/timerange; visually an outline button with a caret for file type. keep tooltip copy minimal: "Error context 1 top frames + metadata. Expand to view stack or copy request id." inside tooltip keep only "Copy id" link.

 tom (Product): copy note: prefer `Export trace` over `Download snapshot`. add microcopy inside modal: "Includes filters, time range, visible frames, and correlation IDs." we should mention retained pii policy in small print.

 anjali (Eng): backend will include a small metadata JSON with correlation_id and sample_tags. HAR generation will be behind an opt-in flag. fine to default to JSON.

 sophie (Design): keyboard shortcut idea: `Shift+Cmd+E` / `Shift+Ctrl+E` depending on OS. also add it to the command palette so power users discover it.

 noah (A11y): prefer `Shift+E` as simpler but check global conflicts. if we expose both platform-specific combos that's good. ensure screenreader announces the shortcut.

 tom (Product): product asks we add an audit event for export (user + request id + type) for compliance. anjali can you add that to the backend ticket?

 anjali (Eng): yep I'll create backend task and flag latency expectations. also will return a job-id in the response so frontend can poll status.

 deploy-bot: preview available: https://ui-stage.redwood.ai/ux/trace-export-171401 — includes header export button, export modal, and shortcut demo.

 sophie (Design): sweet. I'll update Figma (export as outline, right grouped with filters) and add a11y annotations: aria-label template, focus rules, and contrast swatches. tagging you all now.

 tom (Product): thanks — let's quick sign-off tomorrow 9am PT. small checklist: copy tweak, analytics event, a11y checklist, backend job id.

 noah (A11y): will run a pre-release a11y pass on the preview and post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:
